1	"""WebSocket-based notification server.
2	
3	- Accepts WebSocket connections and assigns each client a unique ID.
4	- Broadcasts messages to all connected clients, or routes a message to one
5	  specific client ("direct"), or emits server-originated "system" messages.
6	- Cleans up the client registry on disconnect.
7	- Exposes GET /health (plain HTTP, served via the websockets handshake hook)
8	  returning the number of currently connected clients.
9	- Persists an audit trail of every event to a flat JSON-Lines file — no
10	  database is used anywhere in this service.
11	"""
12	
13	import argparse
14	import asyncio
15	import json
16	import logging
17	from pathlib import Path
18	
19	import websockets
20	from websockets.datastructures import Headers
21	from websockets.http11 import Response
22	
23	from .messages import MessageError, encode, make_message, now_iso, parse_client_message
24	from .registry import ClientRegistry
25	from .storage import FlatFileStorage
26	
27	logger = logging.getLogger("notification_server")
28	
29	DEFAULT_DATA_PATH = Path(__file__).parent / "data" / "events.jsonl"
30	
31	
32	class NotificationServer:
33	    def __init__(self, host="localhost", port=8765, storage_path=DEFAULT_DATA_PATH):
34	        self.host = host
35	        self.port = port
36	        self.registry = ClientRegistry()
37	        self.storage = FlatFileStorage(storage_path)
38	        self._server = None
39	
40	    # ── connection lifecycle ────────────────────────────────────
41	
42	    async def handler(self, websocket):
43	        client_id = self.registry.add(websocket)
44	        self.storage.append_event(
45	            {"event": "connect", "client_id": client_id, "timestamp": now_iso()}
46	        )
47	        try:
48	            welcome = make_message("system", {"event": "connected", "client_id": client_id})
49	            await websocket.send(encode(welcome))
50	            async for raw in websocket:
51	                await self._dispatch(client_id, websocket, raw)
52	        except websockets.exceptions.ConnectionClosed:
53	            pass
54	        finally:
55	            self.registry.remove(client_id)
56	            self.storage.append_event(
57	                {"event": "disconnect", "client_id": client_id, "timestamp": now_iso()}
58	            )
59	
60	    async def _dispatch(self, client_id, websocket, raw):
61	        try:
62	            data = parse_client_message(raw)
63	        except MessageError as exc:
64	            error = make_message("system", {"event": "error", "detail": str(exc)})
65	            await self._safe_send(websocket, encode(error))
66	            return
67	
68	        msg_type = data["type"]
69	        payload = data["payload"]
70	        self.storage.append_event(
71	            {
72	                "event": "message",
73	                "type": msg_type,
74	                "from": client_id,
75	                "payload": payload,
76	                "timestamp": now_iso(),
77	            }
78	        )
79	
80	        if msg_type == "broadcast":
81	            await self.broadcast(payload, sender_id=client_id)
82	        elif msg_type == "direct":
83	            target_id = payload.get("target_id")
84	            content = payload.get("content", {})
85	            delivered = await self.send_direct(target_id, content, sender_id=client_id)
86	            if not delivered:
87	                error = make_message(
88	                    "system", {"event": "error", "detail": f"unknown target_id: {target_id!r}"}
89	                )
90	                await self._safe_send(websocket, encode(error))
91	        elif msg_type == "system":
92	            ack = make_message("system", {"event": "ack"})
93	            await self._safe_send(websocket, encode(ack))
94	
95	    # ── message delivery ────────────────────────────────────────
96	
97	    async def broadcast(self, payload, sender_id=None):
98	        body = dict(payload)
99	        if sender_id is not None:
100	            body.setdefault("sender_id", sender_id)
101	        message = make_message("broadcast", body)
102	        data = encode(message)
103	        clients = self.registry.all()
104	        if clients:
105	            await asyncio.gather(*(self._safe_send(ws, data) for ws in clients.values()))
106	        return message
107	
108	    async def send_direct(self, target_id, content, sender_id=None) -> bool:
109	        websocket = self.registry.get(target_id)
110	        if websocket is None:
111	            return False
112	        message = make_message(
113	            "direct", {"content": content, "sender_id": sender_id, "target_id": target_id}
114	        )
115	        await self._safe_send(websocket, encode(message))
116	        return True
117	
118	    async def send_system(self, target_id, payload) -> bool:
119	        websocket = self.registry.get(target_id)
120	        if websocket is None:
121	            return False
122	        message = make_message("system", payload)
123	        await self._safe_send(websocket, encode(message))
124	        return True
125	
126	    @staticmethod
127	    async def _safe_send(websocket, data):
128	        try:
129	            await websocket.send(data)
130	        except websockets.exceptions.ConnectionClosed:
131	            pass
132	
133	    # ── REST: GET /health ───────────────────────────────────────
134	
135	    def process_request(self, connection, request):
136	        if request.path == "/health":
137	            body = json.dumps({"connected_clients": self.registry.count()}).encode()
138	            headers = Headers(
139	                [
140	                    ("Content-Type", "application/json"),
141	                    ("Content-Length", str(len(body))),
142	                ]
143	            )
144	            return Response(200, "OK", headers, body)
145	        return None
146	
147	    # ── run/serve ────────────────────────────────────────────────
148	
149	    async def start(self):
150	        self._server = await websockets.serve(
151	            self.handler,
152	            self.host,
153	            self.port,
154	            process_request=self.process_request,
155	        )
156	        logger.info("notification server listening on ws://%s:%s", self.host, self.port)
157	        return self._server
158	
159	    async def stop(self):
160	        if self._server is not None:
161	            self._server.close()
162	            await self._server.wait_closed()
163	            self._server = None
164	
165	    async def serve_forever(self):
166	        await self.start()
167	        await self._server.wait_closed()
168	
169	
170	def main():
171	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="WebSocket notification server")
172	    parser.add_argument("--host", default="localhost")
173	    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=8765)
174	    parser.add_argument("--data", default=str(DEFAULT_DATA_PATH))
175	    args = parser.parse_args()
176	
177	    logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)
178	    server = NotificationServer(host=args.host, port=args.port, storage_path=args.data)
179	    asyncio.run(server.serve_forever())
180	
181	
182	if __name__ == "__main__":
183	    main()

1	"""JSON message envelope shared by every message on the wire.
2	
3	Every message is: {"type": str, "payload": dict, "timestamp": str}
4	"""
5	
6	import json
7	from datetime import datetime, timezone
8	
9	SUPPORTED_TYPES = {"broadcast", "direct", "system"}
10	
11	
12	def now_iso() -> str:
13	    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
14	
15	
16	def make_message(msg_type: str, payload: dict) -> dict:
17	    if msg_type not in SUPPORTED_TYPES:
18	        raise ValueError(f"unsupported message type: {msg_type}")
19	    return {"type": msg_type, "payload": payload, "timestamp": now_iso()}
20	
21	
22	def encode(message: dict) -> str:
23	    return json.dumps(message)
24	
25	
26	class MessageError(Exception):
27	    pass
28	
29	
30	def parse_client_message(raw: str) -> dict:
31	    """Parse and validate a raw client message. Raises MessageError on failure."""
32	    try:
33	        data = json.loads(raw)
34	    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
35	        raise MessageError("invalid_json") from exc
36	
37	    if not isinstance(data, dict):
38	        raise MessageError("message must be a JSON object")
39	
40	    msg_type = data.get("type")
41	    if msg_type not in SUPPORTED_TYPES:
42	        raise MessageError(f"unsupported type: {msg_type!r}")
43	
44	    payload = data.get("payload", {})
45	    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
46	        raise MessageError("payload must be an object")
47	
48	    return {"type": msg_type, "payload": payload}

1	"""Thread-safe in-memory registry mapping client IDs to WebSocket connections."""
2	
3	import threading
4	import uuid
5	
6	
7	class ClientRegistry:
8	    def __init__(self):
9	        self._lock = threading.Lock()
10	        self._clients = {}
11	
12	    def add(self, websocket, client_id=None) -> str:
13	        client_id = client_id or str(uuid.uuid4())
14	        with self._lock:
15	            self._clients[client_id] = websocket
16	        return client_id
17	
18	    def remove(self, client_id) -> None:
19	        with self._lock:
20	            self._clients.pop(client_id, None)
21	
22	    def get(self, client_id):
23	        with self._lock:
24	            return self._clients.get(client_id)
25	
26	    def all(self) -> dict:
27	        with self._lock:
28	            return dict(self._clients)
29	
30	    def count(self) -> int:
31	        with self._lock:
32	            return len(self._clients)
33

1	"""Flat-file (JSON Lines) event storage. No databases — every event is appended
2	as one JSON object per line to a plain text file on disk."""
3	
4	import json
5	import threading
6	from pathlib import Path
7	
8	
9	class FlatFileStorage:
10	    def __init__(self, path):
11	        self.path = Path(path)
12	        self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
13	        self._lock = threading.Lock()
14	
15	    def append_event(self, event: dict) -> None:
16	        line = json.dumps(event)
17	        with self._lock:
18	            with open(self.path, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
19	                f.write(line + "\n")
20	
21	    def read_events(self) -> list:
22	        with self._lock:
23	            if not self.path.exists():
24	                return []
25	            with open(self.path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
26	                return [json.loads(line) for line in f if line.strip()]
27	
28	    def clear(self) -> None:
29	        with self._lock:
30	            if self.path.exists():
31	                self.path.unlink()

1	"""
2	Codebase seed — Minimal Flask Todo API (tier 1, good seams)
3	
4	A single-file Flask app with clean structure: models, routes, error handling.
5	Designed as a baseline for multi-session stories.
6	"""

8	from flask import Flask, request, jsonify
9	from datetime import datetime
10	import sqlite3
11	import os
12	
13	app = Flask(__name__)
14	
15	DATABASE = os.environ.get("DATABASE", "todos.db")
16	
17	
18	def get_db():
19	    conn = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE)
20	    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
21	    return conn
22	
23	
24	def init_db():
25	    with get_db() as conn:
26	        conn.execute(
27	            "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tasks ("
28	            "  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,"
29	            "  title TEXT NOT NULL,"
30	            "  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',"
31	            "  created_at TEXT NOT NULL"
32	            ")"
33	        )
34	
35	
36	# ── Models ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
37	
38	def create_task(title: str) -> dict:
39	    with get_db() as conn:
40	        now = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
41	        cursor = conn.execute(
42	            "INSERT INTO tasks (title, status, created_at) VALUES (?, 'pending', ?)",
43	            (title, now),
44	        )
45	        conn.commit()
46	        return {
47	            "id": cursor.lastrowid,
48	            "title": title,
49	            "status": "pending",
50	            "created_at": now,
51	        }
52	
53	
54	def get_tasks():
55	    with get_db() as conn:
56	        rows = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM tasks ORDER BY created_at DESC").fetchall()
57	        return [dict(r) for r in rows]
58	
59	
60	def get_task(task_id: int) -> dict | None:
61	    with get_db() as conn:
62	        row = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM tasks WHERE id = ?", (task_id,)).fetchone()
63	        return dict(row) if row else None
64	
65	
66	def update_task(task_id: int, title: str | None = None, status: str | None = None) -> dict | None:
67	    task = get_task(task_id)
68	    if task is None:
69	        return None
70	    with get_db() as conn:
71	        updates = []
72	        params = []
73	        if title is not None:
74	            updates.append("title = ?")
75	            params.append(title)
76	        if status is not None:
77	            updates.append("status = ?")
78	            params.append(status)
79	        if updates:
80	            params.append(task_id)
81	            conn.execute(
82	                f"UPDATE tasks SET {', '.join(updates)} WHERE id = ?", params
83	            )
84	            conn.commit()
85	    return get_task(task_id)
86	
87	
88	# ── Routes ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
89	
90	@app.route("/tasks", methods=["GET"])

95	@app.route("/tasks", methods=["POST"])

97	    data = request.get_json(silent=True) or {}
98	    title = data.get("title", "").strip()
99	    if not title:
100	        return jsonify({"error": "title is required"}), 400
101	    task = create_task(title)
102	    return jsonify(task), 201

104	
105	@app.route("/tasks/<int:task_id>", methods=["GET"])

108	    if task is None:
109	        return jsonify({"error": "task not found"}), 404
110	    return jsonify(task)

112	
113	@app.route("/tasks/<int:task_id>", methods=["PUT"])

    async def _handle_subscribe(self, client_id, websocket, payload):
        channel = payload.get("channel")
        if not channel:
            error = make_message("system", {"event": "error", "detail": "channel is required"})
            await self._safe_send(websocket, encode(error))
            return
        self.channels.subscribe(channel, client_id)
        ack = make_message("system", {"event": "subscribed", "channel": channel})
        await self._safe_send(websocket, encode(ack))

    async def _handle_unsubscribe(self, client_id, websocket, payload):
        channel = payload.get("channel")
        if not channel:
            error = make_message("system", {"event": "error", "detail": "channel is required"})
            await self._safe_send(websocket, encode(error))
            return
        self.channels.unsubscribe(channel, client_id)
        ack = make_message("system", {"event": "unsubscribed", "channel": channel})
        await self._safe_send(websocket, encode(ack))

async def broadcast(self, payload, sender_id=None):
        body = dict(payload)
        if sender_id is not None:
            body.setdefault("sender_id", sender_id)
        message = make_message("broadcast", body)
        data = encode(message)
        clients = self.registry.all()
        if clients:
            await asyncio.gather(*(self._safe_send(ws, data) for ws in clients.values()))
        return message
